neighbours.label: Low-confidence guess: the word right before a count where a number is expected next ('a total of| 25 studies', 'all| 50 states', 'more than| 800'); the same sentences without a number stay quiet.
fire: The survey reached a total of 1,200 households.
The museum holds more than 3,000 paintings.
The review included a total of 41 trials.
The race drew more than 900 runners.
Volunteers visited all 12 villages in the valley.
The library lends out a total of 300 books a week.
Teams from each of the 20 provinces took part.
quiet: The survey reached many households in the region.
The museum holds many famous paintings.
The review included several large trials.
The race drew runners from abroad.
Volunteers visited every village in the valley.
The library lends out many books each week.
Teams from every province took part.

notes: Card: ' than' x9, ' ' x8 (the space before '50'), ' of' x3, ' all' x2 (a total⟦ of⟧ 25 publications; each of the⟦ ⟧50 States; all⟦ ⟧50 states); output promotes number words ' three', ' five'. Exploratory probe weak: 'a total of 25' 0.25, 'all 50 states' 0.10. Expected to fail.
